name: Segub
overview: Segub is a biblical figure noted primarily as the son of Hiel, who rebuilt Jericho in direct fulfillment of God's judgment as foretold through Joshua (1 Kings 16:34). He is also identified as a grandson of Judah through Hezron, emphasizing his place within the Messianic lineage (1 Chronicles 2:21-22). Segub's lineage continued with his son Jair, who was granted dominion over twenty-three cities in Gilead, illustrating God's providential blessing on this family line (1 Chronicles 2:22). These passages highlight God's sovereign hand in both judgment and blessing through the generations of His chosen people.
